title: 情報セキュリティ
subtitle: Information Security
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1) Learn an overview of information security technology and its necessity.
(2) Learn basic knowledge of technologies such as cryptography and authentication.
(3) Learn application systems such as antivirus, digital watermarking, and biometric authentication.
advice:
This is a basic course on information security. The following materials will be covered:

1. Information security
 - overview of security technology
2. Cryptographic technology
 - common-key cryptosystem, and public-key cryptosystem
3. Authentication technology
 - hash function, digital signature
4. Security tools
 - client authentication, PKI, PGP, IPsec, TLS, and SSH
5. Application system
 - antivirus, countermeasures for unauthorized access, digital watermarking, and biometric authentication
6. Information ethics
 - ethical issues in information security

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Be able to fully understand and explain information security technology.
(2) Be able to fully understand and explain the mechanisms of standard cryptography.
(3) Be able to fully understand and explain the mechanisms of standard authentication technology.
(4) Be able to fully understand and utilize the functions of standard security tools.
(5) Be able to fully understand and explain the security application system.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Be able to understand and explain information security technology.
(2) Be able to understand and explain the mechanisms of standard encryption technology.
(3) Be able to understand and explain the mechanisms of standard authentication technology.
(4) Be able to understand and use standard security tools.
(5) Be able to understand and explain security application systems.
